description: This file defines a PHP class that extends a base filter parameters class for search filtering related to educational qualifications within the OrangeHRM system. It specifies allowed sort fields and sets a default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: QualificationEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that extends FilterParams to provide specific filtering parameters for searching educational qualifications in the system. It defines allowed sorting fields and sets a default sort order.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters by setting the default sort field to 'e.name'.
